t: Dine apiyyat hammatztza ubeezeh matztza yotze yede chobato
s: Dine apiyyat hammatztza ubeezeh matztza yotze yede chobato ubo k"t seipim: tannur sheapu bo chametz kesherotzeh leepot bo matztza — tzarik lehakshiro al yede libbun baur, kedin keli cheres sheen lo heksher ella al yede libbun. Lepikak, tzarik lehassiqo kol kak ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot nittazin mimmenna, shebbepachot mikken eno niqra libbun gamur, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"a. Vetzarik lizzaher sheyyeleku haggechalim al pene kullo (kede lehakshir et kullo), veen day lo (lehakshiro) belehaba bilbad, lepi shekkemo shebbekol hashshana keshenneepa chametz betoko bolea mammash al yede gechalim (shemmepazzerim otam al gabbe hattannur qodem haapiyya) — kak hu poleto al yede gechalim. Lepikak, apillu im hissiquhu kamma peamim qodem happesach — eno maspiq lehattir leepot bo matztza lekattechilla, ella im ken kivven lehattiro letzorek happesach, ki shemma lo haleku haggechalim al pene kullo kol zeman shello nitkavven lekak. Abal bediabad sheabar veapa bo matztzot — yesh lehattiram baakila, dekevan shehussaq kamma peamim qarob haddabar shehayu gechalim al pene kullo, paam bemiqtzat zeh upaam bemiqtzat zeh. Abal im lo hussaq ella paam achat velo kivven lehattiro letzorek happesach al yede hesseq zeh vesapeq lanu im haleku haggechalim al pene kullo — yesh leesor apillu bediabad:

Yesh nohagin lehattil battannur qarqa chadasha kede shello yitztareku lehakshiro al yede hesseq, shehechametz habbalua begaggo ubeqirotayv hu niplat al yede libbun hashshalhebet keshemmassiqin oto leepot bo hammatztzot. Uminhag yapeh hu. Ubilbad sheyyattilu bo qarqa aba bikde etzba o yoter al pene kullo, abal hatacha muetet enah moelet kelum, sheenah mapseqet bipne giul chametz habbalua beqarqaito hayshana shello yetze lachutz:

Keshemmakshiro al yede hesseq — tob veyashar hu legorpo ulenaqqoto heteb achar hahesseq ulehamtin ad sheyyitztannen qetzat veachar kak yachazor veyassiquhu shenit leepot bo hammatztzot, sheim lo yassiquhu shenit ella yopeh bo miyyad leachar sheggarap haggechalim achar hahesseq harishon, veken im lo yamtin ben hesseq lehesseq ad sheyyitztannen qetzat — yesh lachosh shemma lo yassiqennu heteb kol kak bahesseq harishon shemmassiqo lehakshiro, lepi sheyyityare shello yissarepu hammatztzot sheyyopeh bo achar hesseq harishon o achar hesseq hashsheni:

Tappeqa shel cheres chadasha, dehaynu keli shemmassiqin tachtayv millematta veopin al gabbah milmala — muttar leepot alayv matztzot, dekevan shehaur sholet tachtayv hu nirtach yapeh ap al pi sheen hashshalhebet ola al gabbayv, vehappat neepet miyyad veenah baa lide chimmutz. Abal yesh lizzaher lehassiq tachtayv techilla ad sheyyihyeh murtach heteb veachar kak yadbiq happat al gabbayv. Veken kesheopeh beilpas belo mashqeh [yizzaher] lehassiq tachtayv techilla ad sheyyihyeh murtach heteb veachar kak yadbiq happat betokah, sheim yadbiq happat mittechilla veachar kak yartichennu — yesh lachosh shemma qodem sheyyihyeh murtach heteb tachmitz happat. Vaapillu bediabad sheabar vehidbiq veachar kak hirtiach — nakon lehachamir shello leoklah bepesach im epshar lo:

Im samu matztza al hanneyar betok hattannur leepotah im hanneyar — en lehachamir bah bediabad, shebbevadday shalat bah chom haur derek hanneyar veneepet bimhera qodem shettaspiq lehitchammetz, abal lekattechilla tob lizzaher shello laasot ken:

Tob lehachamir velimchot shello yopeh chararot beremetz, veken shello yopeh bachamma, sheyyesh lachosh shemma yachmitzu qodem sheyyatchilu leepot. Veim abar veapa beremetz — muttarot baakila, umuttar latzet bahen yede chobato. Abal im abar veapa bachamma, ap al pi shemmuttarot baakila, dekevan shehachom gadol kol kak ad sheyyukal leepot en hachom menichan lehitchammetz ella miyyad hen matchilin leheapot, mikkol maqom en adam yotze bahen yede chobato apillu bediabad, lepi shehaapuy bachamma eno qaruy lechem kelal, vehattora omra: "lechem oni". Abal haapuy bechom haur qaruy lechem ap al pi sheeno neepa battannur ella bailpas belo mashqeh:

Veken im neepa baqqarqa, kegon teroqanin, vehu sheosin guma beqarqa hakkira venotenin sham qemach umayim meorabin veneepeh sham. Ap al pi shebbelilatah rakka meod veen alayv tzurat pat ulekak en mebarekin alayv "hammotzi" ella im ken qaba alayv seudato kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch — ap al pi ken adam yotze bo yede chobato bepesach apillu lekattechilla, lepi shezzehu "lechem oni", sheen leani tannur veopeh lachmo baqqarqa:

Matztza shenneepet ad sheim poresin otah en chutin nimshakin mimmenna, ap al pi shehi nipreket keshemmetaltelin otah — ap al pi ken yotzein bah apillu lekattechilla, abal qodem shenneepet kashshiur hazzeh — enah niqret lechem ella issa, vehaokelah lo yatza yede chobato. Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher shello lehotziah min hattannur qodem shenneepet kashshiur hazzeh ap sheyyachazirenna miyyad, dekevan shehi niqret issa yekola hi labo lide chimmutz keshehi chutz lattannur. Veim abar vehotziah, ben shehechezirah ben shello hechezirah kelal — mutteret baakila. Veyesh oserin apillu hechezirah miyyad, dekevan shehammatztza hi chamma yesh lachosh shemma nitchammetza berega echad zo shehayeta chutz lattannur, ki al yede hachamimut memaheret lehachmitz apillu bepachot mishshiur mil, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"t. Veap hammardeh shehotziuha bah min hattannur asura, ki shemma nitchammetza beodah al hammardeh chutz lattannur:

Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag leesor matztza shechutin nimshakin mimmenna. Veim en yekolin laamod aleha im chutin nimshakin mimmenna im lav — tob lehachamir uleosrah missapeq. Umikkol maqom, im tocheb etzbao letokah veen batzeq nidbaq bo — en lehistappeq kelal im chutin nimshakin mimmenna. Veim adayin lo qaremu paneha — beyadua shechutin nimshakin mimmenna:

Veim hechezirah lattannur keshehi shelema shello perasah lirot im chutin nimshakin mimmenna — yesh lehattirah im qaremu paneha qetzat keshehotziah, veyesh lismok bazeh al sebara harishona shello lehachaziq issur missapeq lomar shemma haya chutin nimshakin mimmenna:

Vehammardeh im hotziu bah matztza shehayu chutin nimshakin mimmenna — en leosrah ella lekattechilla, sheen lehotzi bah od matztzot, abal bediabad yesh lismok al sebara harishona shello leesor hammatztzot shehotzi bah achar kak:

Yotze adam yede chobato bematztza sheruya bemayim leachar apiyyatah, vehu shello nimmocha. Veap al pi shennitmasmesa bammayim — lo yatza(t)h mikkelal lechem kol zeman shello nimmocha legamre. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob shello latzet bematztza sheruya, ella im ken hu zaqen o choleh veqasheh lo leekol matztza yebesha — az shorin lo bemayim. Vetzarik lizzaher shello tehe nishret bammayim k"d shaot, shekkol hannishreh meet leet niqra kabush, vahare hu kimbushshal, veen yotzein bematztza mebushshelet, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vetzarik lizzaher lishrot kezayit shalem beyachad, abal im yashreh perusot pechutot mikkezayit — eno yotze bahen yede chobato im nishru kol kak ad shennitlabbenu hammayim mechamatan, shekkebar nitbattelu mittorat lechem, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch. Velo yashreh ella bemayim, abal lo bishar mashqin ume perot, velo bemaraq, lepi shehen mepigin et taam hammatztza, shennotenin bah taam shellahem. Veap al pi sheen tzarik sheyyitom taam matztza bepiv, sheapillu bala matztza velo leasah — yatza kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"h, mikkol maqom hammatztza atzmah tzarik sheyyihyeh bah taam matztza, velo sheyyupag tamah al yede taam acher:

Umikkol maqom, im hazzaqen o hacholeh i epshar lo leekol matztza hashsheruya bemayim — shorin lo beyayin o bishar mashqin, kede shello yitbattel mimmitzvat matztza, ki yesh omerim sheap hayyayin ushear mashqin enan mepigin taam hammatztza, kevan shello nitbashshela bahen ella shennishret bahen. Abal shear kol adam sheakal matztza hashsheruya bishar kol hammashqin chutz mimmayim — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor veleekol matztza acheret, ben hakkezayit shel birkat matztza ben hakkezayit shel apiqoman, ki haiqqar kassebara harishona:

En yotzein bematztza hammebushshelet leachar apiyyatah apillu bediabad, apillu lezaqen o lecholeh, lepi shehabbishshul mebattel et taam hammatztza. Vaapillu lo nitbashshela berotechin ella shennopla letok mayim chammin shehayyad soledet bo vehesirah miyyad — hare hi niqret mebushshelet, veen yotzein bah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennopla letok keli rishon, abal im nopla letok keli sheni — yotzein bah, shekkeli sheni eno mebashshel. Umikkol maqom, yesh lehachamir lekattechilla im lo letzorek, lepi sheyyesh mistappeqin vechosheshin al happat shemma hi mitbashshelet ap bikli sheni, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"ch:
Din matztza shenneepet im chametz betannur echad o im nageu zeh bazeh — nitbaer besiman tm"z, ayyen sham:

Matztza shennitkappela battannur venitdabbeqa sham bimqom hakkepel, im hu qodem happesach, apillu beereb pesach mishshesh shaot ulemala — mesir meqom hakkepel sheyyesh bo chashash chimmutz, ki shemma lo haya chom haesh yakol lishlot bekoach ben haddebaqim lehatchil leepot sham miyyad venitchammetz sham qodem shehitchil leepot sham, umesir od meqom maggao, dehaynu kerochab gudal samuk limqom hakkepel, kedin chametz shennaga bematztza sheoser meqom maggao beomeq kerochab gudal kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z, ushear hammatztza muttar baakila ap al pi sheen bah shishshim neged meqom hakkepel. Abal matztza shenneepet betok happesach venitkappela battannur, apillu lo nitkappel ella mashshehu mimmenna — machamirin leosrah kullah, dekevan shehechametz mechubbar bammatztza bachatika achat — chosheshin shemma nitpashshet taam hechametz bekol hammatztza. Veap al pi sheyyesh bammatztza shishshim negdo — enah mitbattel betokah, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu. Abal im meqom hakkepel hazzeh nitchabber battannur bematztza acheret apillu hen noshekin (ayyen siman tn"z) — eno oser et kullah, veday bintilat meqom maggao kerochab gudal, lepi shehanneshika enah mechabberet otan lihyot kachatika achat mammash:

Veim meqom hakkepel hu mashuach beshumman venaga bematztza acheret chamma shehayyad soledet bo, veken im otah matztza shennoga bah hi meshucha beshumman bimqom maggaah, ap al pi shemmeqom hakkepel eno mashuach — hare hu oser et kullah, kedin kikkar chametz shennaga bekikkar matztza veechad mehen mashuach beshumman shennitbaer besiman tm"z, ayyen sham hattaam:

Abal im matztza zo shennitkappela noga bematztza acheret shello bimqom hakkepel, ella miqtzatah hashsheni shello nitkappela noga bematztza acheret, apillu shettehen meshuchot beshumman — en tzarik littol bimqom maggaah ella kede qelippa bilbad, lepi shettaam habbalua eno yotze mechatika lachatika belo roteb, apillu shettehen shemenot, ella im ken haissur atzmo hu shamen, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z, ayyen sham hattaam. Vaapillu im shette matztzot hallalu nitchabberu battannur ad shennasheku zo bezo — en hanneshika mechabbartan lihyot kachatika achat mammash, ella kishte chatikot shennageu zo bezo, veen issur habbalua yotze mechatika lachatika belo roteb:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennitchabberu zo betzad zo, dehaynu sheobi matztza zo nitchabber loobi matztza zo, abal im miqtzat matztza zo haya munnach battannur al miqtzat matztza zo, ap al pi shello nitchabberu zo lezo, ella shehayu debuqin zo lezo, dehaynu shehayu munnachin battannur zo al gab zo mammash beli shum hepseq avir benetayim — shettehen asurot, lepi shemmeqom haddibbuq yesh lo din matztza kepula, sheen haesh sholet sham, vehu oser et kol matztza zo, veet kol matztza zo shehu mechabber lishtehen. Veim hu qodem happesach — mesir meqom haddibbuq im rochab gudal mimmatztza zo verochab gudal mimmatztza zo:

Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher shello yiggeu hammatztzot battannur apillu zo betzad zo, lepi shebbimqom negiatan en chom haesh sholet sham. Abal bediabad mutteret apillu nasheku zo bezo, dekevan shechom haesh sholet bekol shetach hammatztza millematta umilmala — hi neepet yapeh veenah baa lide chimmutz:

Keshemmesir meqom hakkepel im meqom maggao mimmatztza kepula betok happesach o beereb pesach mishshaa shishshit ulemala — tob lehachamir ulesorpam im epshar lo, ap al pi sheen chametz barur ella chashash beolma:

En oserin matztza kepula ella kesheshshene tzidde hakkepel hem debuqin zeh lazeh, dehaynu munnachin zeh al gab zeh mammash beli shum hepseq avir benetayim, sheaz yesh lachosh shemma en chom haesh sholet sham. Abal im enan debuqin mammash ella shehen semukin zeh lazeh, ap al pi shekkimat hen debuqin — en leosrah apillu hen betok happesach, dekevan sheyyesh meat hepseq benehem — chom haesh sholet sham yapeh umatchil leepot sham qodem sheyyaspiq lehatchil lehachmitz. Umikkol maqom, im sham bimqom hakkepel lo qaremu paneha — asura lepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer lemala:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu lehachamir [veleesor] matztza shehi nepucha beemtzaitah, dehaynu shettapach gup hammatztza venaaset kehar beemtzaitah al yede haapiyya, kederek hechametz shemmitchammetz umitnasse lemala beemtzaitah:

Matztza sheala aleha qerum kederek sheoleh al happat bishat apiyya — mutteret. Abal im obi hammatztza nechlaq lishnayim vetzad haelyon ala lemala veyesh chalal beemtzaitah — hare zo niqret gam ken nepucha, venohagim leosrah im hechalal ala lemala, dehaynu shehatztzad haelyon ala gam ken lemala, ad shehechalal shennaasa tachtayv gam ken hu gaboah mishshetach pene hammatztza asher sebibayv:

Veen oserin ella im ken hechalal hu gadol kol kak, kemo egoz luz (sheqqorin hazil nos), o kemo etzba godel benoni, az neesra kol hammatztza apillu hu qodem pesach, veyesh bammatztza shishshim keneged maqom hannapuach, lepi shehannapuach shebbemaqom echad megalleh hechametz shel kol hammatztza, shello nitassequ bah eseq gamur lebattel hatchalat hachimmutz, ulepikak keshehoshibuha battannur al yede chom hattannur — yatza bah chimmutz lappoal venitgalla boshtah, ulepikak nitpecha:

Veim lo ala hechalal lemala ella shebbetok obi hammatztza yesh neqeb chalal keshiur shennitbaer — oserin meqom hanneqeb bilbad, sheoto maqom domeh lematztza kepula sheen chom haesh sholet sham, vehashshear muttar apillu hu tok happesach. Veen oserin apillu meqom hanneqeb ella kesheyyesh betoko ababuot sheqqorin blazly"k shehem siman lechimmutz, abal im hu chalaq muttar. Veim yesh bammatztza shene neqabim keachat neqeb betok neqeb — chosheshin leesor kullah:

Vekol issurin ellu shennitbaer bematztza kepula unepucha en lahem iqqar baggemara, veenan ella minhag shennahagu baddorot haacharonim. Veap al pi sheen lanu lehaqel bedabar sheabotenu nahagu bo issur, mishshum shenneemar "veal tittosh torat immeka", mikkol maqom en lehachamir bahem kemo bechametz gamur sheoser taarobto bemashshehu betok happesach, veday lehachamir leesor otah matztza atzmah shennitkappela o shennitpecha abal lo taarobtah:

Veken en tzarik lehassiq ulehakshir et hattannur bammaqom sheyyoshba alayv hammatztza, veken hammardeh shehotziuha bah min hattannur en leesor otah ella lekattechilla im epshar lo beacheret, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"a. Veken bishar kol hakkelim shennishtammeshu bah ubaleu mimmenna:
Veken im abar aleha happesach mutteret baakila, shehare en bah ella chashash chimmutz, usepeq chametz sheabar alayv happesach — muttar, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"ch:
